title: Kidnapped Dragons
description: Earth has entered an apocalyptic state, and Yu Jitae has repeatedly failed to save it. Whenever he dies, his Authority, Vintage Clock, sends him back in time. After countless regressions, Yu Jitae finally realizes that the four dragons responsible for the world's destruction must be raised differently. In his seventh iteration, the strongest being in the world chooses an unexpected path: becoming the guardian of four young dragons and trying to change the fate that has doomed humanity.
author: Yuzu
